name: Alien Clock
promptTemplate: An alien cosmic clock across {{dimensions}} dimensions with The Eye: {{the_eye}}, squaring: {{squaring}}, spiral galaxy: {{spiral_galaxy}}, and sectors: {{sectors}}. The vision features alt reality: {{alt_reality}}, horizontal vision: {{horizontal_vision}}, continuity: {{continuity}}, return homage: {{return_homage}}, and bugz: {{bugz}}. This is edition {{edition}}.

credit.title: Alien Clock
credit.description:
_Somewhere in a galaxy far away, a multidimensional being is looking at this clock and thinking about the impermanence of existence and the infinity of the universe. This art is endless and deterministic._ 

**Use full screen for total immersion.**

Controls: 

- Click/tap or use keys 1 to 9 to switch speed. 
- s = toggle starts. 
- t = toggle hyperspace. 
- Space = pause.
